You are implementing Task 3: the reassembly-error mapping in the local driver.

## Task Description
Read your task brief first — it is your requirements, with the exact values to use verbatim:
/Users/smaschek/dev/paigasus/paigasus-helikon-sma-864/.superpowers/sdd/2026-11-27-sma-864-no-tool-calls-after-length/task-3-brief.md
Also read the global constraints (they bind every task):
/Users/smaschek/dev/paigasus/paigasus-helikon-sma-864/.superpowers/sdd/2026-11-27-sma-864-no-tool-calls-after-length/global-constraints.md

## Context
SMA-864: the agent loop must not run tool calls from a model turn that ended with `FinishReason::Length` or `ContentFilter`.
- Task 1 (f2b252cc) added `AgentError::ToolCallsNotRun { finish_reason: Option<FinishReason>, tool_names: Vec<String> }` in `crates/paigasus-helikon-core/src/agent.rs` (variant `#[non_exhaustive]`; match with `..` from external tests).
- Task 2 (e3434f48) added a guard arm in the pure `transition` (`loop_state.rs`): CallingModel + ModelResponse with Length/ContentFilter and ≥1 ToolCall → `Failed(ToolCallsNotRun{..})`, events MessageOutput… then RunFailed.
- The gap Task 3 closes: when the tool-call args are partial JSON, `ModelTurnAccumulator::finish()` (model.rs) returns Err ("invalid tool args") before `transition` sees the turn. The local driver (agent.rs, the `acc.finish()` error arm ~line 1505) maps that Err to `AgentError::Other` and `RunFailed`. For a Length/ContentFilter turn it must become `ToolCallsNotRun` instead.

Rulings: the two accessors are new `pub` methods on `ModelTurnAccumulator`; give each a `///` doc comment that does not intra-doc-link any private item. `tool_call_names` returns names in `call_id` order, matching the order the accumulator already uses when it builds items — check how `build_items` orders tool calls and use the same order. Do NOT add `finish_seen()` (Task 7 does that). Build the error once and use `err.to_string()` for the RunFailed text so the slot and the event agree. Follow how the existing error arm sets the failure slot.

## Before You Begin
If anything in the brief is unclear, ask now.

## Your Job
1. Write the 4 tests in the new file (TDD); run and record which pass/fail before the change (the brief predicts which).
2. Implement. 3. Verify. 4. `cargo fmt --all` and `cargo clippy --workspace --all-features --all-targets -- -D warnings` clean. 5. Commit, staging by explicit path. 6. Self-review. 7. Report.

Work from: /Users/smaschek/dev/paigasus/paigasus-helikon-sma-864 (absolute paths; `cd ... || exit 1`).

Safety: never run git checkout, switch, reset, rebase, stash, or anything that moves HEAD or a branch. Do not push. Do not dispatch subagents of any kind. Run every cargo command in the foreground and wait for it to end; do not end your turn until every command has finished. If the commit fails with a 1Password error, stop and report BLOCKED; never bypass signing.

Known pre-existing issue: core `tests/trybuild_ui.rs` fails locally on rustc 1.99 diagnostic text, also without any change. Ignore it, mention it, do not re-bless.

While iterating, run the focused test; run `cargo test -p paigasus-helikon-core` once before committing.

## Self-Review
Completeness, quality, YAGNI, existing patterns, pristine test output. Fix issues before reporting.

## Report Format
Write the full report to:
/Users/smaschek/dev/paigasus/paigasus-helikon-sma-864/.superpowers/sdd/2026-11-27-sma-864-no-tool-calls-after-length/task-3-report.md
Include: what you implemented, tests and results, TDD evidence (RED command + output + why expected; GREEN command + output), files changed, self-review findings, concerns.

Then reply with ONLY (under 15 lines): Status (DONE | DONE_WITH_CONCERNS | BLOCKED | NEEDS_CONTEXT), commits (short SHA + subject), one-line test summary, concerns, report file path.

Only a SubagentHandback call reaches your caller as your result; plain text you write at the end is not delivered. Do not also send the report with SendMessage: your caller would get it twice.

### Task 3: The reassembly-error mapping in the local driver

**Files:**
- Modify: `crates/paigasus-helikon-core/src/model.rs` (`ModelTurnAccumulator`, ~line 680)
- Modify: `crates/paigasus-helikon-core/src/agent.rs` (the `acc.finish()` error arm, ~line 1505)
- Test: `crates/paigasus-helikon-core/tests/tool_calls_not_run.rs`

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes: Task 1, Task 2.
- Produces (public, additive, each with `///`):
  - `ModelTurnAccumulator::finish_reason(&self) -> &FinishReason` — the reason of the last `Finish` seen (today's default `Stop` if none).
  - `ModelTurnAccumulator::tool_call_names(&self) -> Vec<String>` — the names of the accumulated tool calls in `call_id` order; a call with no name gives `""`.
  - Task 7 adds `finish_seen()`; do not add it here.
- Driver rule: read both accessors **before** `acc.finish()` consumes `acc`. On `Err(e)`: if the reason is `Length` or `ContentFilter`, set the failure slot to `ToolCallsNotRun { finish_reason: Some(reason), tool_names }` and yield `RunFailed { error: <that error>.to_string() }`; otherwise keep today's `AgentError::Other` and `RunFailed { error: e }`.

- [ ] **Step 1: Write the failing tests** (driver-level, with `common::MockModel::with_scripts`, `common::MockTool::new("search", json!({}))`, and `RunResultStreaming::new(stream).collect().await` as in `tests/failure_slot.rs:144`):
  1. `length_turn_with_empty_args_runs_no_tool` — script: `ToolCallDelta { call_id: "c1", name: Some("search"), args_delta: "" }`, `Finish { Length }`. Assert `tool.invocations().is_empty()` and the error matches `RunError::Agent(AgentError::ToolCallsNotRun { finish_reason: Some(FinishReason::Length), .. })`.
  2. `length_turn_with_partial_json_runs_no_tool` — the same with `args_delta: "{\"q\": \"ab"`.
  3. `reassembly_error_under_stop_keeps_other` — partial JSON + `Finish { Stop }` → `RunError::Agent(AgentError::Other(_))`.
  4. `cut_call_is_not_recorded_in_the_session` — test 1's run with a session (use the in-memory session the other core session tests use; find it with `grep -rn "InMemorySession\|SessionRecorder" crates/paigasus-helikon-core/tests`). After the run, the session holds no `tool_call` and no `tool_returned` record for `c1`. If test 1's script has assistant text, the assistant message is there.
- [ ] **Step 2:** Run `cargo test -p paigasus-helikon-core --test tool_calls_not_run` → test 1 PASS (Task 2 already covers it), tests 2 FAIL (gives `Other`), 3 PASS, 4 PASS or FAIL. Record which.
- [ ] **Step 3:** Add the two accessors and the driver rule.
- [ ] **Step 4:** Run the same command → all PASS. Run `cargo test -p paigasus-helikon-core` → PASS.
- [ ] **Step 5:** Commit `fix(core): SMA-864 map a cut-turn reassembly error to ToolCallsNotRun`.

======
## Global Constraints

- Work only in the worktree `/Users/smaschek/dev/paigasus/paigasus-helikon-sma-864`. Use worktree-absolute paths. Do not run `git checkout`, `git switch`, `git reset`, `git rebase` or any command that moves HEAD or another branch.
- Run every cargo command in the foreground and wait for it to end. Do not background it.
- Commit messages: `<type>(<scope>): SMA-864 <lowercase subject>`. Allowed scopes here: `core`, `runtime-temporal`, `providers`, `providers-anthropic`, `providers-openai`, `docs`, `specs`, `plan`. There is no `providers-bedrock`/`providers-litellm`/`providers-gemini` scope; use `providers`.
- End each commit message with `Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>`.
- Stage files by explicit path. Never `git add -A` or `git add .` (`.env` and `.claude/` are not ignored).
- Before each commit: `cargo fmt --all` and `cargo clippy --workspace --all-features --all-targets -- -D warnings` must be clean.
- Every new public item gets a `///` doc comment (`missing_docs`, `-D warnings` docs gate). A public doc comment must not intra-doc-link a private item.
- Error variant name and shape (exact): `AgentError::ToolCallsNotRun { finish_reason: Option<FinishReason>, tool_names: Vec<String> }`, with `#[non_exhaustive]` on the variant.
- Blocked finish reasons (exact): `FinishReason::Length` and `FinishReason::ContentFilter`. All other reasons, including `Stop` and `Other(_)`, keep today's behavior.
- Name cap in the `Display` text: the same rule as `format_blank_names` in `crates/paigasus-helikon-core/src/model.rs` (8 names, 64 characters each).

- Do not dispatch subagents. Do not push. Work synchronously and in the foreground; do not end your turn until every command you started has finished.
- Commits are signed with a 1Password SSH key. If a commit fails with "failed to fill whole buffer", stop and report BLOCKED (the vault is locked); never bypass signing.
